facts.fact: The Data Protection Office of Mauritius issued guidance in September 2026 to Management Companies on registering as controllers and processors with the Commissioner under the Data Protection Act 2017.
The Data Protection Office guidance of September 2026 applies the Data Protection Act 2017 as the law in force on registration and Data Protection Officer duties.
The Data Protection Office, with a Commissioner who takes registrations, issued current guidance under the Act in September 2026.
The guidance cites the Data Protection (Designation, Tasks and Position of Data Protection Officers) Regulations 2026 and the Data Protection (Fees) Regulations 2020 as made under the Act.

The Data Protection Office issued guidance requiring Management Companies to register as controller and processor and to designate their own Data Protection Officer, with no decision on a named entity.
The Data Protection Office's September 2026 guidance applies the Data Protection Act 2017 and the Data Protection Officers Regulations 2026 to Management Companies.
The Data Protection Office, with a Commissioner who takes registrations, issued the guidance itself in September 2026.
The Data Protection Office issued guidance on registration of controllers and processors and on Data Protection Officers, and says it may carry out site visits.
